Depth is how far an index goes, each stop adding to the one before: Names; Text, the words inside files; Text + OCR, text in images and scanned pages; Meaning on documents, search by meaning over documents and images; and Meaning on all files, about three times the indexing time of Meaning on documents. For a library ACTIVATE Studio builds it is a choice: one built here applies a new depth in the background at once. One built on a remote system applies it when it is rebuilt, which is offered as the depth changes, and its row says so until then. An index connected as it is stays as it was built.
